label: Cauzzi & Faccioli (2008)
units: SD in cm at the API boundary; the model's own units and log base are kept under parameters
validityScope: Single-site intensity only; no spatial correlation, so never use it to draw a correlated field across multiple assets. Valid only inside its own published magnitude, distance, period and damping envelope, recorded under parameters; outside it the wrapper refuses unless the caller sets allow_extrapolation. Not usable at version 0.1.0: coefficients are anchor_only - one anchor branch (horizontal PGA) is reproducible from the specification appendix, but the spectral table and a median kernel are not in the repository - so construction raises CoefficientsUnavailable and no capability is declared. What is missing is named under parameters.coefficients.needed.

source.catalogue: Douglas, J. (2011). Ground-motion prediction equations 1964-2010. PEER Report 2011/102 / BRGM/RP-59356-FR.
source.benchmark_spec: gmpe_30_coding_prompts.md, sections 3 and 4 - the 30-family benchmark set definition.
source.caveat: Douglas (2011) is a catalogue, not a ranking, and warns that a report of its size may contain errors or omissions. Every envelope below is its summary, frequently approximate. Nothing here substitutes for the original publication.
source.coefficient_appendix: gmpe_30_coding_prompts_with_coefficients.md sections 11 and 12 - coefficients transcribed from Douglas (2011), with an explicit per-model completeness status and a coefficient-completeness gate.

parameters.label: Cauzzi & Faccioli (2008)

distance.implementation_note: OpenQuake clips Rhypo at 15 km 'as per Ezio Faccioli's personal communication'. That clip is not in Douglas (2011); do not adopt it without a source.

site.anchor_note: Resolved from the aB/aC/aD site coefficients; A is the reference class.

mechanism.anchor_note: The horizontal-PGA anchor block contains no mechanism term. The displacement-spectrum branches may differ.

coefficients.needed: The ELECTRONIC SUPPLEMENTARY MATERIAL displacement-spectrum tables for all four damping ratios. Only the horizontal-PGA anchor (a1, a2, a3, aB, aC, aD, sigma) is available.

implementation_notes: Reject a damping ratio that is not published unless a separately documented interpolation rule exists.
Broadband digital-record model; displacement response is the emphasis.
parameters.component_note: The anchor branch is labelled horizontal, but which horizontal definition is not stated.

resolution_provenance.distance.min_km: Douglas (2011) BRGM/RP-59356-FR, Illustration 1 (PGA characteristics table): rmin 6* km (rhypo)
resolution_provenance.distance.max_km: Douglas (2011) BRGM/RP-59356-FR, Illustration 1 (PGA characteristics table): rmax 150* km (rhypo)
resolution_provenance.distance.approximate: Douglas (2011) BRGM/RP-59356-FR, Illustration 1 (PGA characteristics table): values starred
resolution_provenance.component: Douglas (2011) BRGM/RP-59356-FR, Illustration 1 (PGA characteristics table) and Douglas (2011) BRGM/RP-59356-FR, Illustration 2 (spectral characteristics table): component code G; OpenQuake hazardlib (gem/oq-engine master, retrieved 2026-10-04), openquake/hazardlib/gsim/cauzzi_faccioli_2008.py declares IMC.GEOMETRIC_MEAN ('On functional forms', p. 462)
resolution_provenance.periods.grid: OpenQuake hazardlib (gem/oq-engine master, retrieved 2026-10-04), openquake/hazardlib/gsim/cauzzi_faccioli_2008.py (CauzziFaccioli2008.COEFFS, 'constructed from the electronic supplements') coefficient table; period count and range (400 periods, 0.05-20 s) match Douglas (2011) BRGM/RP-59356-FR, Illustration 2 (spectral characteristics table). External implementation, original paper not checked. Grid is 0.05 to 20.00 s in 0.05 s steps. The OpenQuake table carries two further rows (20.03, 21.03 s) outside the published 0.05-20 s range; they are excluded.
